categories.main_business_segments: ASAHI INTECC operates two main business segments: the Medical Division, which develops, manufactures, and sells minimally invasive medical devices (primarily guidewires and catheters for vascular interventions), and the Device Division, which develops and manufactures components for both medical and industrial applications, supplying these to manufacturers worldwide.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include wire drawing (producing ultra-fine wires from alloys), wire forming (twisting, flattening, coiling, and braiding wires), coating (applying functional polymer layers), and torque technology (enabling high rotational followability in wires and cables). These proprietary technologies enable integrated production from raw materials to finished products, supporting high-precision, high-performance devices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are hospitals and medical institutions (for the Medical Division), as well as medical device and industrial equipment manufacturers (for the Device Division). The main end markets are interventional cardiology, peripheral, abdominal, and neurovascular procedures, as well as various industrial sectors such as automotive, construction, and leisure.
categories.geographic_coverage: ASAHI INTECC has a global footprint, supplying products to 121 countries and regions. Major markets include Japan, the United States, Europe (notably France, Germany, Italy), China, and emerging markets in Asia, the Middle East, Oceania, and South America. Production is concentrated in Thailand, Vietnam, and the Philippines, with R&D centers in Japan and overseas sales subsidiaries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates both upstream and downstream: it manufactures core materials and components (upstream/midstream) and also produces and sells finished medical devices under its own brand (downstream), as well as supplying OEM/ODM products to other manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maintaining global niche leadership in cardiovascular devices, expanding into non-cardiovascular and high-value-added therapeutic devices, and strengthening the business portfolio. R&D focuses on next-generation minimally invasive devices, leveraging core technologies, and collaborating with top clinicians. The company is also investing in sustainability, digital transformation, and global R&D/production optimization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of proprietary medical devices (direct and via distributors), OEM/ODM manufacturing for other companies, and sales of industrial components. The company also receives contract development fees and, to a lesser extent, licensing and service revenues.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ASAHI INTECC is a global niche leader in PCI guidewires and catheters, holding high market shares in Japan, the US, Europe, and China. Key competitors include major global medical device companies such as Terumo, Boston Scientific, and Abbott. In industrial components, competition comes from Asian manufacturers, especially in Korea and China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending June 2025, consolidated net sales reached ¥120.0 billion, with operating profit of ¥30.1 billion and net income attributable to parent company shareholders of ¥12.7 billion. The company has demonstrated strong growth, with sales increasing by over 11% year-on-year, and aims for further expansion to ¥180 billion in sales by 2030 and ¥300 billion by 2035.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ASAHI INTECC differentiates itself through proprietary, integrated manufacturing from raw materials to finished devices, enabling high-performance, reliable, and innovative products tailored to clinical needs. Its 'Only One' and 'Number One' strategy emphasizes unique technologies, comprehensive product lineups, and close collaboration with leading physicians, resulting in superior clinical outcomes and global market leadership in minimally invasive therapies.
